scenes.audio: A high-pitched, digital 'ding' sound effect followed by a continuous mechanical clicking sound, similar to a ticking clock or a counting machine.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A static wide shot with a clean white background. A horizontal progress bar is centered. A black pill-shaped graphic sits at the 69.0% mark on the slider. The lighting is uniform, bright, and artificial, creating a flat 2D graphic aesthetic. The color palette is minimal, consisting of white, black, and light gray.

scenes.audio: The mechanical clicking sound continues at a rapid pace, increasing in frequency as the graphic slides.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The camera remains static. An animation begins where a second black pill-shaped graphic slides rapidly to the right along the horizontal bar. A purple line grows behind the moving graphic, filling the space between the 69.0% mark and the new position. The movement is smooth with a slight speed ramp at the start.

scenes.audio: A final, sharp 'ding' sound effect plays as the movement stops and the final number appears. The clicking sound ceases instantly, leaving a brief moment of silence.
scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.visual: The animation stops as the second graphic reaches the 75.4% mark. A purple numerical value with a plus sign appears below the bar. The background remains a solid, sterile white. The lighting is consistent with previous scenes, showing no shadows or depth.
